label: Cryosphere
text: EA.O.A4.4 Cryosphere. Glaciers, ice sheets, sea ice, permafrost and snow as surface mass. Mass balance (accumulation minus ablation) is the core claim. Glacier flow by Glen's flow law assumes power-law creep of polycrystalline ice with exponent near 3 (UNVERIFIED exponent range). Glacial landforms are EA.O.A4.1.

warrant.standard: Field or remote measurement with accuracy assessment; process model calibrated and validated
